NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 28, 10:04 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 27.8 DraftKings points for $9,500, against Minnesota. Kenneth Walker III (22.9, $8,800) and Kyren Williams (21.2, $7,500) are next.

Jahmyr Gibbs is also the top value at the position: 2.92 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 28, 10:04 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 8

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET vs MIN ($9,500)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 27.8 DraftKings points at $9,500, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.8 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 22.8 carries and 5.6 targets. The salary works out to 2.92 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 27.6 points with a simulated floor of 15.2 and a ceiling of 45.0, and he holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC at DEN ($8,800)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 22.9 DraftKings points at $8,800, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 19.4 carries and 4.1 targets. The salary works out to 2.61 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 22.8 points with a simulated floor of 10.9 and a ceiling of 41.2, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against Denver, with an implied team total of 21.5 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Kyren Williams, LAR vs LAC ($7,500)

Kyren Williams projects 3rd at the position with 21.2 DraftKings points at $7,500, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 15.5 carries and 4.9 targets. The salary works out to 2.83 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 21.2 points with a simulated floor of 9.4 and a ceiling of 38.8, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 44.5.

Value: Chase Brown, CIN vs TEN ($6,300)

Chase Brown projects for 18.3 DraftKings points at $6,300, which works out to 2.91 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 22 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 16.4 carries and 4.8 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 33.0, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 10-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 28.25 in a game totaled at 46.5.
